0022600137.text: The Bulls (1-3, 0-1 at home) host the 0-3 Knicks in Chicago for Chicago's fifth game of the 2026-27 season; the Bulls are on a two-game losing streak, sit 11th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Central, while New York is on a three-game losing streak and is 13th in the East. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while New York is without Jose Alvarado, who is out with an ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Bulls lost 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York in their last meeting.
